name: IACC Food Bank (Plano Masjid)
hoursNotes: Weekly Saturday morning distribution; drive-thru and walk-up both available.
requirements: Open to everyone regardless of background or faith. No appointment necessary.
notes: Fresh produce, fresh meats, and pantry staples; diapers and formula when in stock. Staff also help with SNAP and WIC forms. The mosque runs free health and dental clinics for the uninsured: https://planomasjid.org/health-clinics
